sentence.sent_text: Ishke a'aw mindimooyenyiban, mii iw gaa-tazhindang maagizhaa gaye inow meshkwadooniganan, maagizhaa gaye odaabaanan, maagizhaa gaye waakaa'igan.

paragraph.text_eng: That old lady said those material things were of no value. What is worth more is the compassion we show each other as close relatives especially during that time we have lost someone close to us.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke gii-ikido a'aw mindimooyenyiban, gaawiin wiin gegoo apiitendaagwasinoon iniw.
Nawaj apiitendaagwad i'iw da-ni-zhawenindiyang wenjida besho enawendaasoyang o'owapii wani'ang a'aw besho enawemang.

paragraph.text_eng: She said when it is our time to come over there, there is a small bundle that we carry on our back. In that bundle we carry all the good things we have done for one another including the compassion for our fellow human beings, that has more value; we don’t take those material things with us. That’s what that old lady talked about.

sentence.sent_text: Gii-ikido azhigwa enendaagoziyang gaye giinawind iwidi da-ni-naazikaageyang, mii i'iw bimiwanaan ge-bimoondamang.
Mii imaa ani-maajiidooyang i'iw gakina wenaajiwang i'iw zhewenimang a'aw giwiiji-bimaadiziiminaan, mii o'ow maamawe-apiitendaagwak; gaawiin i'iw gida-ni-maajiidoosiimin.
Mii i'iw mindimooyenyiban gaa-tazhindang.

paragraph.text_eng: I am now completing the talk that goes with this.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke mii dash omaa eni-giizhiikamaan o'ow gaagiigidowin eyaamagak.

paragraph.text_eng: You are doing Waasigwan good.

sentence.sent_text: Geget gimino-doodawaawaa a'aw Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: He will go where our Anishinaabe go when they are no longer seen here on earth.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go iwidi ge-ni-izhaad a'aw gidanishinaabeminaan eni-izhaad gaagwiinawaabaminaagozid omaa akiing.

paragraph.text_eng: See, there are some Anishinaabe that view our ways as inferior and reject it, they are doing wrong.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke aanind a'aw Anishinaabe ani-aanawendang i'iw akeyaa gaa-izhi-miinigoowiziyang, maazhichige geget.

paragraph.text_eng: If an Anishinaabe is sent a different way, he or she does not go anywhere.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke bakaan izhi-maajaa'ind, gaawiin ingoji da-izhaasiin a'aw Anishinaabe.

paragraph.text_eng: You are doing right by Waasigwan.

sentence.sent_text: Geget dash gimino-doodawaawaa a'aw Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: May the Manidoog have compassion for you for doing this.

sentence.sent_text: Gidaa-wii-shawenimigowaag dash ingiw Manidoog.

paragraph.text_eng: Tomorrow we will start at 10 o’clock.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash i'iw waabanokeyang, mii iw midaaso-diba'iganek da-ni-maajitaayang.

paragraph.text_eng: That’s all I am going to say.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa minik inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Thank you for listening to me.

sentence.sent_text: Miigwech bizindawiyeg.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell those present to smoke the tobacco.

sentence.sent_text: Wiindamawindwaa eyaajig imaa da-naabishkaagewaad inow asemaan.

paragraph.text_eng: First all the items that are needed for the funeral are put in place, and this is what will be done:

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw akawe da-asisijigaadeg waa-ni-aabajichigaadeg ani-maajaa'iweng, mii dash ge-izhichigeng:

paragraph.text_eng: If the deceased is male, then a man will prepare him for his journey. Likewise if the deceased is female, it is only a female who will prepare her for her journey.

sentence.sent_text: Giishpin ininiiwid gaa-ishkwaa-ayaad, booch inow ininiwan oda-ozhiitaa'igoon.
Mii-go naasaab a'aw ikwe, booch inow ikwewan oda-ozhiitaa'igoon

paragraph.text_eng: Buckskin moccasins are to be placed on the deceased the morning of the funeral. Make sure buckskin is used to make those moccasins.

sentence.sent_text: Bashkwegino-makizinan da-biizikoonaa gigizhebaawigadinig apii i'iw giizhigadinig waa-ni-maajaa'ind gaa-ishkwaa-ayaad.
Booch i'iw bashkwegin da-aabajichigaadeg izhichigaadeg iniw makizinan.

paragraph.text_eng: The body has to be covered from the waist down with a hand-made quilt, or maybe the deceased's favorite blanket.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw da-agwazhe'ind dabazhish imaa okaading.
Mii dash i'iw maamandoogwaason da-aabajichigaadeg, gemaa gaye i'iw waabooyaan gaa-wenda-zaagitood.

paragraph.text_eng: Plug tobacco is placed in between the fingers. The plug tobacco is cut into pieces; three on the right hand, two on the left.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa gendidawizid a'aw asemaa da-achigaazod baabiitawayi'ii inow oninjiing.
Mii iw da-giishkizhigaazod a'aw asemaa; niswi dash da-achigaazowan gichinikaang inow oninjiing, naa niizh iwidi namanjinikaang oninjiing.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at this time that the lunch is made for the deceased. Bits and pieces of the food that has been brought in are put into the small birch bark basket. The basket containing the food is put into one of the bags that the deceased is taking. If it is a man that is about to go on his journey, it is one of his male relatives that will prepare his lunch. If the deceased is female, it is one of the female relatives who will prepare her lunch.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii onaawapwan izhichigaadenig a'aw waa-ni-maajaad.
Mii imaa bakwebijigaadeg i'iw wiisiniwin gaa-piindigajigaadeg, mii dash imaa achigaadeg biskitenaagaansing.
Mii dash imaa biina'igaadeg bezhig i'iw mashkimodensing waa-ni-maadjiidood.
Giishpin ininiiwid a'aw waa-ni-maajaad, mii inow bezhig ininiiwan besho enawemaajin, mii inow ge-ozisidamaagojin waa-naawapod da-atamaagod imaa biskitenaagaansing.
Mii-go gaye giishpin ikwewid waa-ni-aanjikiid, mii inow bezhig inow ikwewan besho enawemaajin da-naadamaagod da-ozisidamaagod ow naawapwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: In the other travel bag four strips of birch bark and four matches are placed. If the deceased is a male, a knife is placed in the bag. If the deceased is a woman, a sewing kit is placed into the bag.

sentence.sent_text: Iwedi dash bezhig i'iw mashkimod, mii imaa niiwin gaa-kiishkibijigaadeg i'iw wiigwaas biina'igaadenig miinawaa niiwin ishkodensan.
Mookomaanens dash da-atamawaa giishpin ininiiwid waa-ni-maajaa'ind.
Mii dash wiin a'aw ikwe waa-ni-maajaa'ind, mii imaa biina'igaadenig ge-aabajitood da-gashkigwaasod.

paragraph.text_eng: The food is laid out and uncovered. Bowls are placed in front of the casket from which the relatives will eat. The bowls will then be passed to the close relatives before everyone attending the funeral is served. Mille Lacs is the only place that this is done this particular way. For those in other communities a platter is placed in front of the casket from which the close relatives will eat. The close relatives will form a circle around that platter as they eat the food.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw gayat gii-kiizisijigaadeg i'iw wiisiniwin miinawaa gii-paakaakonigaadeg.
Mii-go gaye iw wiisiniwin gii-achigaadeg imaa boozikinaaganan gii-kiizisijigaadeg ge-ondanjigewaad ingiw besho enawendaasojig.
Mii dash da-maada'oonindwaa besho enawendaasojig dabwaa-agwaaba'amowaad waa-miijiwaad ingiw gaa-pi-naazikaagejig.
Mii eta-go imaa Misi-zaaga'iganing ezhichigeng.
Mii dash aanind bakaan endanakiijig, mii eta-go bezhig chi-onaagan imaa achigaadeg i'iw wiisiniwin ge-ondanjigewaad ingiw besho enawendaasojig.
Mii imaa waakaabiwaad ingiw besho enawendaasojig endazhi-wiisiniwaad.

paragraph.text_eng: This is when you will get up and tell everyone to accept the tobacco on behalf of the Manidoog that was passed out to them. They can smoke their pipes or take the tobacco to the fire.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash omaa da-ni-wiindamaageng da-ni-naabishkaageng a'aw asemaa gaa-maada'ookiing.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has been passed out to all of you.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw gii-paa-maada'oonigooyeg a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: It is here that you will accept the tobacco on behalf of the Manidoog.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-naabishkaageyeg.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco is being handed to the Manidoog and it is from there that Waasigwan will be helped to finish changing worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii a'aw asemaa ininamawindwaa ingiw Manidoog ge-onjikaamagadinig-sa a'aw Waasigwan da-ni-naadamaagoowizid weweni da-ni-giizhiikang da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: We are doing good to the Manidoog by putting out tobacco to them first so that we are able to complete what we are doing today.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke mii imaa weweni ani-doodawindwaa ingiw Manidoog ani-niigaaninind a'aw asemaa weweni igo imaa da-ni-giizhiitaayang waa-ni-izhichigeyang noongom.

paragraph.text_eng: As we finish accepting the tobacco on behalf of those Manidoog, I will go on to talk about what the tobacco is designated for, and also go on and talk about the food.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash imaa ani-giizhi-naabishkaageyang a'aw asemaa, mii dash imaa da-ni-gaandoweyaan da-ni-wiindamaageyaan enagimind a'aw asemaa, naa biinish gaye da-ni-dazhindamaan i'iw wiisiniwin

paragraph.text_eng: So let’s accept the tobacco on behalf of those Manidoog ina good way.

sentence.sent_text: Akawe dash omaa weweni naabishkaagedaa a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: This is all I am going to say for the time being.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa akawe minik inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell what the tobacco is designated for and talk for the food.

sentence.sent_text: Dazhinjigaazod enagimind a'aw asemaa biinish gaye wiisiniwin dazhinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: Now you will talk about where the tobacco goes and about the food.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-dazhinjigaazod enagimind a'aw asemaa biinish gaye da-ni-dazhinjigaadeg i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has gone out.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash gii-maadaabasod a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: It has gone out to everywhere those Manidoog were seated.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin ingoji aanzweyaabasosiin gii-kikinawaadabi'indwaa ingiw Manidoog.

paragraph.text_eng: It is from there that Waasigwan will get his help, making sure that he arrives at that beautiful place our people go to that is known as “Land of Everlasting Happiness.”

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa ge-ondiniged a'aw Waasigwan weweni da-ni-naadamaagoowizid da-ni-dagoshimoonod iwidi wenda-onaajiwang i'iw "Gaagige-minawaanigoziwining" ezhiwiinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: This is what the tobacco is intended for; we are doing those Manidoog good in appreciation for all they put in place to help our people when it is time for Anishinaabe to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw asemaa enagimind, mii imaa weweni gidoodawaanaanig ingiw Manidoog.
Geget nebowa imaa ogii-atoonaawaa-sa ge-ni-naadamaagod a'aw Anishinaabe apii enendaagozid da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: A lot has been put in place here to help Waasigwan as he goes along on his journey to that beautiful place people go to when they are no longer seen on earth.

sentence.sent_text: Nebowa imaa gii-achigaadeni ge-ni-naadamaagod a'aw Waasigwan eni-apiichitaad biinish iwidi da-ni dagoshimoonod eni-izhaad a'aw gidinawemaaganinaan gaagwiinawaabaminaagozid omaa akiing.

paragraph.text_eng: As the tobacco goes out, the tobacco will go to those Manidoog who were talked about last night, the ones that took pity on the Anishinaabe people, the ones that gave us this teaching to do this ceremony, and also had given us as Anishinaabe a place to go to when anything happens to us.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash gaye a'aw asemaa ani-maadaabasod, mii gaye iwidi ge-ni-inaabasod ingiw Manidoog imaa dibikong gaa-tazhinjigaazojig ingiw gaa-pi-zhawenimaajig inow odanishinaabemiwaan gii-miinigoowiziyang o'ow akeyaa da-inakamigiziyang naa-go gaye gii-miinigoowiziyang anishinaabewiyang ge-ni-izhaayang gegoo izhiwebiziyang.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco is also going out in hope that the Manidoog will take pity on the close relatives and watch over them through the course of the ceremony today; I am sure we are all in the same frame of mind. It is difficult; it is not easy.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash gaye a'aw asemaa enagimind, mii gaye booch gakina imaa enendamowangen gibagosenimaanaanig ingiw Manidoog-sa omaa da-ni-naadamawindwaa zayaagi-inawendaasojig weweni imaa da-ni-ganawenimigowaad inow Manidoon omaa epiitakamigiziyang omaa noongom.
Ishke zanagad; gaawiin wenipanasinoon.

paragraph.text_eng: The Manidoog will take care of them, and also help them accept the decision that those Manidoog made, that it is time for Waasigwan to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Weweni dash oda-ganawenimigowaan inow Manidoon, biinish gaye da-ni-naadamaagoowiziwaad weweni da-ni-odaapinamowaad-sa gaa-inaakonigewaad ingiw Manidoog-sa o'owapii gii-inendaagozid a'aw Waasigwan da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: As the tobacco goes out, I do not want to forget the Manidoo that the Anishinaabe rely on when they put tobacco; especially in this ceremony we are doing. It is the Manidoo that is referred to as Giganaan.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash gaye ani-maadaabasod a'aw asemaa, gaawiin gaye niwii-wanenimaasiin a'aw Manidoo epenimod a'aw Anishinaabe ani-asemaaked wenjida o'ow akeyaa inakamigiziyang.
Mii dash a'aw Giganaan ezhi-wiinind a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: That tobacco will also go to her. That is the Manidoo that will help if we should forget something or do something wrong. That is the Manidoo that will correct it all. So that Waasigwan is given everything he needs that the Manidoog put here to help the Anishinaabe when it is time for them to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iwidi ge-ni-inaabasod gaye a'aw asemaa.
Ishke mii a'aw ge-ni-naadamaaged giishpin omaa gegoo ani-waniikeyaang ani-waniwebinigeyaang.
Mii a'aw Manidoo ge-ni-nanaa'isidood.
Mii dash a'aw weweni igo a'aw Waasigwan da-ni-wawiinge-ina'oonwewizid gakina imaa ingiw Manidoog gaa-atoowaad-sa ge-naadamaagod a'aw Anishinaabe apii enendaagozid da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: As I talk for the tobacco I also include asking the Manidoog for their compassion and understanding when I translate. It is not out of disrespect for what we have been given as Anishinaabe.

sentence.sent_text: Biinish gaye omaa ani-dazhimag a'aw asemaa, mii omaa gaye ani-gaagiizomagwaa ingiw Manidoog giishpin omaa wii-ni-aanikanootamaageyaan.
Gaawiin gaye da-baapinendamaan i'iw gaa-izhi-ina'oonwewiziyang anishinaabewiyang.

paragraph.text_eng: There is a reason that the language has eluded a lot of our Anishinaabe. The chi-mookomaan made a deliberate effort to deceive us as Anishinaabe. The only reason I translate is with the idea of helping our Anishinaabe.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke gaawiin onjida izhiwebizisiin a'aw Anishinaabe, nebowa gii-waniba'igod i'iw gaa-izhi-miinigod inow Manidoon da-ni-inwed.
Ishke geget gigii-aanooji'igoomin wii-wayezhimigooyang anishinaabewiyang.
Mii eta-go wenji-izhichigeyaan enendamaan da-ondiniged omaa a'aw Anishinaabe da-ni-naadamaagoowizid.

paragraph.text_eng: I also put my own tobacco in the fire. That is the tobacco that I am also sending off to those Manidoog to help me when I am talking for Waasigwan. This is the most difficult talk to do. May they help me be efficient in talking for Waasigwan.

sentence.sent_text: Naa biinish gaye niin iwidi ishkodeng nigii-asaa a'aw indasemaam.
Mii ow eni-apagizondamawagig gaye ingiw Manidoog indaa-wii-naadamaagoog omaa-sa ani-ganoodamawag a'aw Waasigwan.
Ishke mii ow maamaw-zanagak iko ani-gaagiigidod awiya.
Indaa-wii-naadamaagoog dash omaa da-ni-wawiingeziyaan omaa da-ni-naadamawag a'aw Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at this time that I will talk about the food. The food is not sent anywhere at this time. It is at this time that we will share in a meal with the one that is about to leave us when he so wishes, much like feeding someone before they travel a great distance.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash i'iw mii owapii gaye da-ni-dazhindamaan i'iw wiisiniwin.
Gaawiin ingoji apagizonjigaadesinoon o'owapii i'iw wiisiniwin.
Akawe igo omaa weweni gida-wiidoopamaanaan epiitawigendang waa-naganinang iko weweni nawajii'ind awiya waasa wii-ni-izhaad.

paragraph.text_eng: When those old men talked at this point, this is when they encouraged the close relatives to be sure they eat.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash ingiw akiwenziiyibaneg iko omaa gii-ni-gaagiigidowaad, mii omaa iko gii-ayaangwaamimaawaad iniw zayaagi-inawendaasonijin da-ayaangwaamiziwaad da-ni-odaapinamowaad i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan will be happy to see you accepting the food ina good way. If someone does not accept the food, he also will not accept the food. Also no one should take the food outside. Handle the food carefully so it does not fall on the floor.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke oda-minwendaan da-waabandang weweni ani-odaapinameg i'iw wiisiniwin.
Mii-go gaye wiin ge-ni-izhichiged.
Ishke odaapinanzig awiya, mii-go gaye wiin gaawiin oda-odaapinanziin.
Naa-go gaye gego awiya agwajiing odaa-wii-izhiwidoosiin i'iw wiisiniwin.
Naa gaye manaajitoog, gego omaa michisagong daa-wii-pangisinzinoon.

paragraph.text_eng: Also you all will want to remember I cannot start talking until everyone has finished accepting the food, it is then that I will continue talking.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye gidaa-wii-mikwendaanaawaa baanimaa gakina awiya omaa gii-ni-giizhiitaad ani-odaapinang i'iw wiisiniwin, mii dash imaa da-ni-gaandoweyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: That is when I will begin telling Waasigwan what was seen when that Manidoo made that path, and also tell what was put in place to help him as he journeys to that beautiful place called “Land of Everlasting Happiness.”

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash gaye owapii dash da-ni-waawiindamawag a'aw Waasigwan gaa-inaabamind a'aw Manidoo apii gii-ozhitood i'iw miikanens, naa gaye da-ni-dazhindamaan i'iw-sa imaa gaa-achigaadeg ahi-naadamaagod ani-apiichitaad da-ni-naazikaaged iwidi wenda-onaajiwang "Gaagige-minawaanigoziwining" ezhiwiinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: You can now accept the food.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go ge-izhi-odaapinamegiban i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: That is all I will say for now.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa akawe minik inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell those present to smoke the tobacco again.

sentence.sent_text: Wiindamawindwaa eyaajig imaa da-naabishkaagewaad inow asemaan miinawaa.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has been passed out again. Once everyone is done smoking the deceased will be told what he will see as he journeys to the other world.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa gii-ni-maada'ookiing a'aw asemaa miinawaa.
Ani-giizhi-naabishkaageng, mii dash imaa da-ni-wiindamawind waa-ni-maajaad ge-ni-waabandang eni-apiichitaad da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has been passed out to all of you.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw gii-paa-maada'oonigooyeg a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: It is again that you will accept that tobacco on behalf of the Manidoog; it is from there Waasigwan will get his help.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go miinawaa da-ni-naabishkaageyeg, mii omaa ge-ondiniged a'aw Waasigwan da-ni-naadamaagoowizid.

paragraph.text_eng: When you are finished accepting the tobacco on behalf of the Manidoog, it is then that I will go on and tell him what was seen when that Manidoo made that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash imaa ani-giizhi-naabishkaageyeg a'aw asemaa, mii dash imaa da-ni-gaandoweyaan da-ni-waawiindamawag a'aw Waasigwan gaa-inaabamind a'aw Manidoo anpii gii-ozhitood i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: That is all I am saying for now.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa minik inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell the deceased what he will see as he makes his journey down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ani-wiindamawind a'aw gaa-ishkwaa-ayaad gaa-inaabamind a'aw Manidoog apii gii-ozhitood i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at this time that the spirit of the person is told what he will see as he makes that journey to that other world we were given to go to when anything happens to us.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-maajitaang da-ni-wiindamawind a'aw waa-ni-aanjikiid ge-ni-waabandang ani-apiichitaad da-ni-dagoshimoonod iwidi wenda-onaajiwang gii-miinigoowizid a'aw Anishinaabe ge-ni-izhaad gegoo eni-izhiwebizid.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has gone out and it will go to every place those Manidoog were seated.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash gii-maadaabasod a'aw asemaa, gaawiin ingoji aanzweyaabasosiin gii-kikinawaadabi'indwaa ingiw Manidoog.

paragraph.text_eng: It is from there that Waasigwan will get his help in arriving to the “Land of Everlasting Happiness.”

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa ge-ondiniged a'aw Waasigwan weweni da-ni-naadamaagoowizid biinish iwidi weweni da-ni-dagoshimoonod iwidi "Gaagige-minawaanigoziwining" ezhi-wiinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: The Anishinaabe does good as soon as something happens to his relative; right away he puts tobacco every night and the tobacco is also offered up several times in this ceremony.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw Anishinaabe geget minochige gaabige gegoo ani-izhiwebizinid inow odinawemaaganan, mii-go gaabige inow asemaan asaad endaso-dibik naa-go gaye omaa nebowa dasing omaa asaad inow asemaan endanakamigiziyang.

paragraph.text_eng: He does good by not doing things half-heartedly. The Manidoog did not do a half-hearted job; they were efficient and put a lot into what will help the Anishinaabe as he changes worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Minochige debinaak eni-izhichigesig.
Ishke gaawiin debinaak gii-izhichigesiiwag ingiw Manidoog, geget gii-wawiingeziwag inigokwekamig omaa gaa-atoowaad-sa ge-ni-naadamaagod a'aw Anishinaabe apii enendaagozid da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: It is here, Waasigwan, that I will begin telling you what was seen when that Manidoo created that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash mii iw Waasigwan, mii-go omaa wii-ni-maajitaayaan wii-ni-waawiindamoonaan-sa gaa-inaabamind a'aw Manidoo apii gii-ozhitood i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: It is here I am going to tell you what those old men talked about when they talked to those who are meant to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Akawe dash omaa gida-ni-waawiindamoon ingiw akiwenziiyibaneg iko gaa-ni-dazhindamowaad omaa gii-ni-ganoonaawaad inow enendaagozinijin iwidi da-ni-izhaanid.

paragraph.text_eng: As you go towards that land over there, do not look back.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke azhigwa ani-naazikaageyan, gego aabanaabiken.

paragraph.text_eng: Also do not bother with those you are closely related to, you can hurt them.

sentence.sent_text: Naa biinish gaye gego babaamenimaaken ingiw besho enawemajig, gidaa-inigaa'aag.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, this is also what I am saying to you.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go gaye niin eninaan Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is now that your spirit will up and leave your physical body.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii da-ni-naangitaayan da-ni-nagadaman i'iw giwiiyaw.

paragraph.text_eng: You will take four steps.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa niiwing da-ni-dakokiiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is there you will see your doorway.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-waabandaman i'iw gidishkwaandem.

paragraph.text_eng: On either side of the doorway you will see something in its spiritual form, it will come in the form of clothing in order for you to recognize it.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash edawayi'ii i'iw ishkwaandeming gida-waabandaan i'iw menidoowaadak, mii iw ge-izhinaman inow biizikiganan.

paragraph.text_eng: As you look to the right of the doorway they will point out to you a bundle of clothing. The clothing is bright and shiny.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke iwidi akeyaa nebowa a'aw Anishinaabe ezhi-minwiid, mii iwidi inaabiyan giwaabandaanan, gidinoo'amaagoo gaye, iwidi biizikiganan etemagakin.
Mii-go ezhi-waawaateshkaag inow biizikiganan.

paragraph.text_eng: Do not grab those, Waasigwan.

sentence.sent_text: Gego wiin inow mamooken Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: As you look to the other side of the doorway you will see clothing that they are pointing out to you. The clothing looks dull and drab.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi napaaj akeyaa iw ishkwaandeming inaabiyan, mii-go gaye iwidi giwaabandaanan, gidinoo'amaagoo gaye, inow biizikiganan etegin.
Biigizawinaagwadoon wiin inow.

paragraph.text_eng: Those are the ones, Waasigwan, you will take and put on.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash inow Waasigwan ge-mamooyanin da-ni-biizikaman.

paragraph.text_eng: As soon as you put them on, you will see how nice they really are, and you will feel the spiritual energy in them and will be helped by them.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa eni-biizikaman, giwaabandaanan ezhi-onaajiwang, naa gaye gimoozhitoonan ezhi-manidoowaadak inow eni-naadamaagoowiziyan azhigwa ani-biizikaman.

paragraph.text_eng: This is not discounting the clothing your relatives have put on you, those have been put there for a reason to help our people when it is time to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke gaye gaawiin aanawenjigaadesinoon gaa-izhi-biizikoonigooyan, onjida ingiw Manidoog imaa ogii-atoonaawaa-sa da-ni-naadamaagod a'aw Anishinaabe apii inendaagozid da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time you will step through that doorway.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-zaagi-dakokiiyan i'iw ishkwaandem.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that you will see that path that Wenabozho’s nephew made.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-waabandaman i'iw miikanens a'aw Wenabozho inow odoozhiman gaa-ozhitoonid.

paragraph.text_eng: As far as you can look ahead you will see that the path goes straight. It does not go uphill or downhill.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke iwidi niigaan eko-debaabiyan giwaabandaan izhi-gwayak inamo i'iw miikanens.
Gaawiin gaye ogidaakiiwemagasinoon, gaawiin gaye niisaakiiwemagasinoon.

paragraph.text_eng: And as you look down you will see the footprints of the Anishinaabe that have gone on before you. They were wearing buckskin moccasins.

sentence.sent_text: Naa biinish gaye imaa dabazhish inaabiyan giwaabandaan imaa bimikawed a'aw Anishinaabe gaa-ni-niigaaniid.
Bashkwegino-makizinan ogii-piizikaanaawaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Their footprints only go in one direction, the direction you are going; there are none coming back.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iwidi bezhigwaning izhikawewaad iwidi akeyaa izhi-naazikaageyan, gaawiin awiya biijikawesiin.

paragraph.text_eng: Do not let that bother you, Waasigwan, just remember how beautiful that place is that you are going to.

sentence.sent_text: Gego babaamendangen i'iw Waasigwan, eta-go mikwendan ezhi-onaajiwang iwidi eni-izhaayan.

paragraph.text_eng: And you will also have to accept and take the decision those Manidoog made, that it was time for you to change worlds at this time.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye booch weweni da-ni-odaapinaman, da-ni-mamooyan-sa gaa-inaakonigewaad ingiw Manidoog-sa owapii gii-inendaagoziyan da-ni-aanjikiiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: Then you will start going down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash mii i'iw da-ni-maada'adooyan i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking a long time and it will look beautiful, after all it was a Manidoo that made that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh gida-ni-bimose, gida-ni-minwaabishin gaye, aaniish naa a'aw Manidoo gaa-ozhitood i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, as you are going along that path you will look down and the ground will look as if it is reddish.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi Waasigwan megwaa ani-bimi-ayaayan, mii iwidi da-ni-waabandaman dibishkoo gii-miskokamigaa.

paragraph.text_eng: This is where you will stop, squat down and pick the strawberries.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-noogitaayan da-ni-ojijiingwanabiyan da-ni-mawinzoyan dash inow ode'iminan ezhi-wiinjigaadegin.

paragraph.text_eng: As you begin to eat those strawberries you will begin to feel the spiritual energy in them. It will startle you as if you were splashed with water.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa nigaapoonoyan inow ode'iminan gida-moozhitoonan ezhi-manidoowaadak inow.
Mii-go dibishkoo gii-koshkwaabaawe ge-inendaman.

paragraph.text_eng: One portion of that which bothered you is removed and washes down, leaving your spirit.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash i'iw aabiding ani-bakwenigaadeg ani-naazhaabaawemagak i'iw gaa-kagwaadagi'igoyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will grab some of those strawberries and throw them behind, remembering your relatives so they are not lacking spiritual nourishment.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye aanind gimamaag ishkweyaang gidapaginaag da-wii-manezisigwaa ingiw gidinawemaaganag.

paragraph.text_eng: As soon as you have your fill of those strawberries, you will again start walking down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-nigaapoonoyan inow ode'iminan, mii-go miinawaa da-ni-maada'adooyan i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking for a long time.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: After you have been traveling on that path for some time, you will want to stop and rest.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi azhigwa maa minik ani-dagoshimoonoyan, mii iwidi da-wii-ni-noogitaayan da-ni-anwebiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that you will also make your fire.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke gaye mii iwidi da-ni-boodaweyan gaye.

paragraph.text_eng: Your relatives did you good by putting birch bark and matches in there for you.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke geget weweni gigii-toodaagoog ingiw gidinawemaaganag, weweni imaa wiigwaas gigii-atamaagoo naa-go gaye inow ishkodensan.

paragraph.text_eng: And at that time you will eat your lunch. Your relatives also did you good by putting a lunch for you also.

sentence.sent_text: Naa-go gaye mii imaa da-ni-nawajiiyan ginawapwaan.
Ishke gaye weweni gigii-toodaagoog ingiw gidinawemaaganag imaa ogii-atoonaawaa i'iw ginawapwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have rested you will approach the path that Manidoo made and begin walking.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash i'iw azhigwa gaa-te-anwebiyan, mii-go da-ni-naazikaman i'iw miikanens a'aw Manidoo gaa-ozhitood da-ni-maada'adooyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking a long long time.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh miinawaa gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have traveled a great distance down that path you will run into a Manidoo that has been placed there to watch over that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi maa minik azhigwa ani-dagoshimoonoyan gida-odisaa a'aw Manidoo iwidi gaa-asind da-ganawendang i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: Your relatives also did you good.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke weweni gaye gigii-toodaagoog ingiw gidinawemaaganag.

paragraph.text_eng: They put tobacco in there for you. You take a piece of that tobacco and hand it to the Manidoo.

sentence.sent_text: Weweni imaa asemaa gigii-atamaagoo.
Mii ow gimamaa a'aw asemaa ininamawad a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: He makes noises to show his appreciation for you treating him respectfully by giving him tobacco. He listens to you with compassion and he answers you when you tell him where you are going.

sentence.sent_text: Naa aapidek waa-inwewetood ezhi-minwendang-sa weweni ani-doodawad ani-biindaakoonad, naa gaye gizhawenimitaag naa gaye ginanaakomig-sa imaa ani-wiindamawad iwidi ezhi-naazikaageyan.

paragraph.text_eng: He points at that path that Wenabozho’s nephew made, allowing you to go further.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go ezhinoo'ang i'iw miikanens a'aw Wenabozho inow odoozhiman gaa-ozhitoonid.

paragraph.text_eng: And again you will start walking down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go miinawaa da-ni-maada'adooyan.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have been down that road for quite some time, you will come upon something that looks bluish on the ground.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash i'iw azhigwa ginwenzh ani-bimi-ayaayan i'iw miikanens megwaa iwidi ani-bimi-ayaayan, mii imaa da-ni-waabandaman imaa dibishkoo gii-ozhaawashkokamigaa.

paragraph.text_eng: It is there you will stop.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-noogitaayan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time you will kneel down.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii da-ni-misabiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time you will pick blueberries.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii da-ni-mawinzoyan inow miinan ezhi-wiinjigaadegin.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have ingested those blueberries, you will feel the spiritual energy within them.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa nigaapoonoyan inow miinan, gimoozhitoonan ezhi-manidoowaadak inow.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that the second portion of what has bothered you washes off.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash i'iw niizhing gii-ni-maajaamagak ani-naazhaabaawemagak i'iw gaa-kagwaadagi'igoyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will also take some of them and throw them behind so that your relatives are not lacking.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye aanind gimamaag, ishkweyaang gidapaginaag da-wii-manezisigwaa ingiw gidinawemaaganag.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have had your fill of those blueberries, you will continue to walk down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-nigaapoonoyan inow miinan, mii-go da-ni-maada'adooyan i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking a long time again.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh miinawaa da-ni-bimoseyan.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have been walking down that path for a long time, Waasigwan, you will want to stop and rest again.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa dash Waasigwan, ginwenzh gaa-ni-bima'adooyan i'iw miikanens, mii iwidi booch da-wii-ni-noogitaayan miinawaa da-ni-anwebiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: Once again you will make your fire and eat your lunch.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go gaye da-ni-boodaweyan, naa-go gaye da-ni-nawajiiyan i'iw ginawapwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: After you have had enough rest, you will approach that path once again that the Manidoo made and continue on.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-anwebiyan, mii-go iw miinawaa da-ni-naazikaman i'iw miikanens a'aw Manidoo gaa-ozhitood da-ni-maada'adooyan miinawaa.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking for a long long time.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: Now as you are walking along you will come upon a Manidoo. He too has been put there to watch over that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi megwaa ani-bimoseyan, mii iwidi da-odisad a'aw Manidoo gaye wiin iwidi gaa-asind da-ganawendang i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: Your relatives did you good by sending tobacco along with you. What the old men said was that, “Nobody could go further without having their tobacco with them and on them.”

sentence.sent_text: Ishke geget gimino-doodaagoog ingiw gidinawemaaganag imaa weweni asemaa gii-atamaagooyan, mii iw gaa-ikidowaad ingiw akiwenziiyibaneg, "Gaawiin odaa-gashkitoosiin awas da-ni-izhaapan awiya ani-gigishkawaasig ani-bimiwinaasig inow odasemaan."

paragraph.text_eng: You take the tobacco and hand it to the Manidoo.

sentence.sent_text: Mii ow gimamaa a'aw asemaa ininamawad a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: Then he allows you to go further down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa bagidinik awas da-ni-izhaayan.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, I also want to tell you:

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash gaye Waasigwan giwii-wiindamoon.

paragraph.text_eng: You will see that you are able to move faster and move better. It is a result of what the Manidoog had put along the path to help the Anishinaabe when it is time to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke giwaabandaan i'iw eshkam gida-ni-gizhiikaa gida-ni-gizhiimaajii.
Mii imaa wenjikaamagak-sa ingiw Manidoog gaa-atoowaad imaa miikanensing ge-naadamaagod a'aw Anishinaabe apii inendaagozid da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: I was also told not to forget to talk about those side roads on that path.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye nigii-wiindamaagoo da-wanendanziwaan imaa da-ni-dazhindamaan ayaapii bakemo i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: Do not let anyone deceive you, Waasigwan, into taking one of those side roads. Just continue on that path that the Manidoo made.

sentence.sent_text: Gego awiya gidaa-wii-wayezhimigosiin Waasigwan.
Mii-go izhi-aabiji-bima'adoon i'iw miikanens a'aw Manidoo gaa-ozhitood.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, as you continue down that path, you will walk a long time again. As you are going along, it is there you will see something reddish hanging there.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw Waasigwan azhigwa ani-maada'adooyan i'iw miikanens ginwenzh gida-ni-bimose miinawaa.
Mii dash iwidi megwaa ani-bimi-ayaayan, mii imaa da-ni-waabandaman dibishkoo-go gii-miskogoodemagad gegoo.

paragraph.text_eng: This is where you will stop.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-noogitaayan

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that you will bend over.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash da-ni-ojijiingwanigaabawiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is there that you will pick what is known as raspberries.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-mawinzoyan ingiw miskominag ezhi-wiinjigaazojig.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have ingested those raspberries you will feel how spiritually powerful they are. It is said here that you will think that you have been splashed with water.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa nigaapoonoyan ingiw miskominag, gida-ni-moozhi'aag ezhi-manidoowaadiziwaad ingiw.
Mii-go imaa giiwenh gii-segaabaawe ge-inendaman.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time the third portion of what has bothered you washes off.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash i'iw nising gii-ni-maajaamagak, gii-ni-naazhaabaawemagak i'iw gaa-kagwaadagi'igoyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You also throw some behind so that your relatives are not lacking in spiritual nourishment.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye aanind ishkweyaang gidapaginaag da-wii-manezisigwaa ingiw gidinawemaaganag.

paragraph.text_eng: After you have had your fill of raspberries, you will continue down that path once again.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-nigaapoonoyan ingiw miskominag, mii-go miinawaa da-ni-maada'adooyan i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking a long time.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have gone so far, you will stop again to rest.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke iwidi azhigwa maa minik ani-dagoshimoonoyan, mii-go miinawaa iwidi booch da-ni-noogitaayan da-ni-anwebiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will make your fire and eat your lunch again.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go gaye da-ni-boodaweyan naa-go gaye da-ni-nawajiiyan ginawapwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have rested enough, then you will continue down that path again.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-anwebiyan, mii-go da-ni-naazikaman i'iw miikanens da-ni-maada'adooyan i'iw miinawaa.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking for a long time again.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh miinawaa gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: While you are going along, you will come upon a Manidoo who also has been put there to watch over that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi megwaa ani-bimi-ayaayan, mii iwidi da-odisad a'aw Manidoo gaye wiin iwidi gaa-asind da-ganawendang i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: You take your tobacco and hand it to that Manidoo.

sentence.sent_text: Mii ow ani-mamad a'aw asemaa ininamawad a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: This is where he allows you go further down that path and where that which is most especially powerful has been placed that will help our people when it is time to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa bagidinik awas da-ni-izhaayan ani-biindigeyan wenjida meshkawaamagak gaa-achigaadeg da-ni-naadamaagod a'aw Anishinaabe apii inendaagozid da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, once you have gone down that path for a long time, while you are going along, you will be standing there. As you look above you, it will look as if something reddish is hanging.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw Waasigwan azhigwa ginwenzh ani-bimi-ayaayan i'iw miikanens, megwaa iwidi bimi-ayaayan, mii imaa da-ni-niibawiyan, mii imaa ishpiming inaabiyan dibishkoo gii-miskogoodemagad gegoo.

paragraph.text_eng: It is there where you will stop and stand.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-noogigaabawiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that you will be picking plums, as they are called.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa apii da-ni-mawinzoyan ingiw bagesaanag ezhi-wiinjigaazojig.

paragraph.text_eng: As you bite through those plums you will feel how powerful they are.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa ani-baapaashkamadwaa ingiw bagesaanag, gida-moozhi'aag gaye wiinawaa izhi-manidoowaadiziwaad ingiw.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time all that has bothered you washes off.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii gakina eni-maajaamagak, eni-naazhaabaawemagak i'iw gaa-kagwaadagi'igoyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that you will begin to think differently about yourself; it is like you are turning into a Manidoo.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-sa azhigwa bakaan da-inenindizoyan, mii wiin da-gweki-manidoowiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: And you will take some of them and throw them behind, remembering your relatives.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye aanind gimamaag ishkweyaang gida-apaginaag da-manezisigwaa ingiw gidinawemaaganag.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have had your fill of those plums, you will continue down that path heading towards that place our people go.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-nigaapoonoyan ingiw bagesaanag, mii-go ani-maada'adooyan i'iw miikanens da-ni-naazikaageyan miinawaa.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking a long time again.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh miinawaa gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: As you have been going down that path for a long time, you will also have to stop and rest again.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi azhigwa ginwenzh ani-bimi-ayaayan i'iw miikanens, mii iwidi booch miinawaa da-wii-ni-noogitaayan da-ni-anwebiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will also make your fire and eat your lunch.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go gaye da-ni-boodaweyan, naa gaye da-ni-nawajiiyan i'iw ginawapwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have rested, you will approach that path and start walking down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Gaa-te-anwebiyan, mii-go iw da-ni-naazikaman i'iw miikanens miinawaa da-ni-maada'adooyan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will be walking a long time again.

sentence.sent_text: Ginwenzh miinawaa gida-ni-bimose.

paragraph.text_eng: As you go along you will come upon a Manidoo that has been put there to watch over that path also.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi megwaa ani-bimi-ayaayan, mii iwidi da-odisad a'aw Manidoo gaye wiin iwidi gaa-asind da-ganawendang i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: You will take your tobacco placed there for you and hand it to the Manidoo.

sentence.sent_text: Mii ow gimamaa a'aw asemaa gaa-atamaagooyan ininamawad a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that he allows you to go further.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa bagidinik awas da-ni-izhaayan.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, after you have been walking down that path for a long time, as you go along you will come upon that river that exists over there.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash Waasigwan azhigwa ginwenzh ani-bima'adooyan i'iw miikanens, megwaa iwidi ani-bimi-ayaayan mii iwidi da-ni-oditaman i'iw ziibi iwidi eyaamagak.

paragraph.text_eng: That river is really swift.

sentence.sent_text: Geget gizhiijiwan i'iw ziibi.

paragraph.text_eng: Nobody would be able to cross it.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin odaa-gashkitoosiin awiya imaa da-ni-aazhogepan.

paragraph.text_eng: As you look down into the river, you will see a Manidoo lying there.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash imaa dabazhish inaabiyan imaa ziibiing, giwaabamaa zhingishing a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: He is not lying still, he is moving like that river.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin bizaanishinziin, mii-go enaabogod epidenig i'iw ziibi.

paragraph.text_eng: See, Waasigwan, how Anishinaabe are helped when they use their tobacco even over there.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw Waasigwan ezhi-naadamaagoowizid a'aw Anishinaabe geyaabi iwidi ani-aabaji'aad inow asemaan.

paragraph.text_eng: You will take your tobacco and place it there for that Manidoo.

sentence.sent_text: Mii ow gimamaa a'aw asemaa atamawad a'aw Manidoo.

paragraph.text_eng: It is there that he lies still and allows you to climb over his back and cross that river safely.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa izhi-bizaanishing bagidinik-sa imaa weweni ani-akwaandaweyan ani-aazhogeyan i'iw ziibi.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have crossed that river, you are getting close to that place where our relatives are.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa ani-aazhogeyan i'iw ziibi, mii dash iwidi besho ani-dagoshimoonoyan iwidi ayaawaad gidinawemaaganinaanig.

paragraph.text_eng: You can see that community over there and you can see that big wigwam that sits sideways over there.

sentence.sent_text: Gidebaabandaan iwidi oodetoowaad naa gaye gidebaabandaan iwidi i'iw chi-wiigiwaam bemidesing.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, I am going to tell you what is usually told to someone who is making that journey when it is their time. They are told not to look back. If you were to look back at that time you would have seen how ferocious-looking that Manidoo was that allowed you to cross that river.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash Waasigwan gaye giwii-wiindamoon, mii-ko enind awiya azhigwa iwidi inendaagozid da-ni-izhaad, gego aabanaabiken azhigwa iwidi eni-naazikaageyan.
Ishke ishkweyaang inaabiyamban gidaa-gii-waabamaa ezhi-zeginaagozid a'aw Manidoo gaa-pagidinik imaa da-aazhogeyan i'iw ziibi.

paragraph.text_eng: Once a person has crossed that river, he is not able to come back.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke awanjish iwidi gii-ni-aazhoged awiya, gaawiin odaa-gashkitoosiin da-bi-azhegiiwed.

paragraph.text_eng: Don’t let that bother you, Waasigwan, just remember only how beautiful it is where you are going, and that you must accept and take the decision those Manidoo have made that it is your time to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Gego Waasigwan babaamendangen i'iw, eta-go mikwendan izhi-onaajiwang iwidi eni-izhaayan naa gaye booch weweni da-ni-odaapinaman da-ni-mamooyan-sa gaa-inaakonigewaad ingiw Manidoog-sa owapii gii-inendaagoziyan da-ni-aanjikiiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at this time that the Manidoo’s song that has been put here will be used to send you on this journey.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash mii owapii da-ni-aabajichigaadeg i'iw Manidoo-giigidowin imaa gaa-achigaadeg da-ni-maajaa'igoyan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is here that the rattle will be used.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash mii imaa da-ni-aabajichigaazod gaye a'aw zhiishiigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: The rattle is efficient in speaking for his Anishinaabe.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke a'aw wawiingezi ani-ganoodamawaad inow odanishinaabeman.

paragraph.text_eng: And it is also heard everywhere those Manidoog sit.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye biinish gaawiin ingoji da-naaweweshinziin enabiwaad ingiw Manidoog.

paragraph.text_eng: When the rattle is used, that is the sound that will be heard as you go down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke ani-aabajichigaazod a'aw zhiishiigwan, Waasigwan, mii-go ge-ni-inwewemagak imaa ani-bimi-ayaayan i'iw miikanens.

paragraph.text_eng: Those Manidoog will always know where you are at and will take good care of you.

sentence.sent_text: Gida-aabiji-gikenimigoog ingiw Manidoog aaniindi ani-bimi-ayaayan imaa miikanensing, geget weweni gida-ganawenimigoog.

paragraph.text_eng: This is all I am saying for the time being.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa akawe minik inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: The song that is used to send the spirit of the deceased down that path.

sentence.sent_text: I'iw manidoo-giigidowin da-ni-aabajichigaadeg da-ni-maajaa'igod a'aw gaa-ishkwaa-ayaad.

paragraph.text_eng: This is the song that is used to send off the spirit of that person that is about to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa da-ni-aabajichigaadeg i'iw manidoo-giigidowin ge-ni-maajaa'igod a'aw waa-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: First half of the song: You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving in a good way You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving

sentence.sent_text: Mii imaa nitam ena'igaadeg: Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Weweni maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane

paragraph.text_eng: Words for second half of the song: You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving Crawl across the river as you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving You are leaving, you are leaving : You are leaving, you are leaving

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa ena'igaadeg ani-giizhikigaadeg i'iw nagamon: Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Aazhawoode izhaan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane Maajaayan maajaayane

paragraph.text_eng: Finish telling the deceased the final part of the journey.

sentence.sent_text: Omaa nawaj ani-gaagiigidong ani-wiindamawind gaa-ishkwaa-ayaad da-ni-giizhiikang da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: It is here where you finish the talk that has been put here telling the spirit of the deceased what he will see as he approaches that place where our people go when they leave this world and completes his journey to where our relatives are.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa ani-giizhiikigaadeg i'iw gaagiigidowin gaa-achigaadeg omaa ani-wiindamawind a'aw ge-ni-waabandang ani-apiichitaad biinish iwidi da-ni-dagoshimoonod ayaawaad gidinawemaaganinaanig.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, the Manidoog definitely had compassion for their Anishinaabe.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw Waasigwan, geget ingiw Manidoog ogii-shawenimaawaan inow odanishinaabemiwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: They put a lot there that will help you as you go along, finishing your move to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Inigokwekamig imaa gaa-achigaadeg ani-naadamaagoyan ani-apiichitaayan iwidi weweni da-ni-giizhiikaman da-ni-aanjikiiyan.

paragraph.text_eng: There is nothing that you will be scared of. The Manidoog will take care of you as you make your journey.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin gegoo gida-gotanziin.
Weweni gida-ganawenimigoog ingiw Manidoog.

paragraph.text_eng: I have told you that as you cross that river over there, you will see that community over there, where our people are.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash omaa gii-wiindamoonaan gii-ni-aazhogeyan iw ziibi, mii iwidi debaabandaman ayaawaad gidinawemaaganinaanig.

paragraph.text_eng: You will continue on that path again that Wenabozho’s nephew made, approaching that community over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go da-ni-maada'adooyan miinawaa i'iw miikanens a'aw Wenabozho inow odoozhiman gaa-ozhitoonid da-ni-naazikaageyan.

paragraph.text_eng: As you get closer to where our people are, you will see a lot of old men coming to meet you.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash iwidi besho ani-dagoshimoonoyan, gida-waabamaag nebowa ingiw akiwenziiyag gibi-nagishkaagoog.

paragraph.text_eng: You will hear them singing and the sound of their rattles. Do not let this bother you.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go ge-bi-izhi-noondaagoziwaad miinawaa zhiishiigwanan gakina da-bi-madweshimaawaad.
Gego dash babaamenimaaken.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, just keep going and go directly to that place where our people are. When you get there they will take you into this huge wigwam that sits sideways.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go izhi-gwayak iwidi ani-izhaan.
Azhigwa iwidi ani-dagoshimoonoyan Waasigwan, mii iwidi da-ni-biindiganigooyan i'iw chi-wiigiwaam iwidi bemidesing.

paragraph.text_eng: As you go in, you will see how beautiful it is in there.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke imaa ani-biindigeyan geget gida-ni-minwaabishin.

paragraph.text_eng: You will see those shells used in our Midewiwin ceremonies hanging inside that wigwam, and there is a Manidoo in there that will take care of you, and he also has his helpers.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go imaa eni-agoojinowaad ingiw Miigisag biindig, naa gaye Manidoo imaa ayaa biindig weweni gida-ganawenimig, naa gaye inow odooshkaabewisiman odayaawaan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is there that they will keep you four days.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke mii imaa niiyo-giizhik da-ganawenimigooyan.

paragraph.text_eng: The old men said that their days are much different up there than they are here on earth.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash ingiw akiwenziiyibaneg gaa-ikidowaad bakaan inendaagwadini ogiizhigadomiwaa iwidi.

paragraph.text_eng: The length of their days is equivalent to a blink of our eye.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go aabiding bapazangwaabiyang, mii iw ekwaamagadinig wiinawaa ogiizhigadomiwaa.

paragraph.text_eng: Once their four days have passed, the Manidoo in the wigwam tells his helpers, “Go out and tell the people here that a relative of theirs has arrived.”

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa gaa-niiyo-giizhigadinig wiinawaa ogiizhigadomiwaa, mii dash a'aw Manidoo imaa eyaad imaa wiigiwaaming ezhi-wiindamawaad inow odooshkaabewisiman "Daga baa-waawiindamaw imaa eyaajig bi-dagoshinini bezhig inow odinawemaaganiwaan."

paragraph.text_eng: And that is what they do, they go out and tell everyone.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash geget baa-waawiindamaagewaad.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time they release you from that big wigwam.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii Waasigwan da-ni-bagidinigooyan i'iw chi-wiigiwaam.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at that time you will see your relatives that you also had a difficult time seeing leave.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-waabamadwaa gidinawemaaganag gaa-minjinaweziyan gaye giin.

paragraph.text_eng: They come running and you can hear how happy they are to see you have arrived over there safely.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go ezhi-biijibatoowaad naa-go ezhi-noondaagoziwaad ezhi-minwendamowaad-sa waabandamowaad i'iw weweni iwidi ani-dagoshimoonoyan.

paragraph.text_eng: Then your relatives here will put tobacco and food.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash ingiw gidinawemaaganag omaa mii inow asemaan da-asaawaad naa gaye i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that the food is finally sent over there and is also burned. When it arrives over there, you will share in that meal with your relatives who are over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash iwidi bijiinag apagizonjigaadeg naa-go gaye jaagizigaadeg.
Azhigwa iwidi ani-dagoshimoonagak, mii iwidi da-ni-wiidoopamadwaa ingiw gidinawemaaganag iwidi eyaajig.

paragraph.text_eng: Once you have finished eating with them, it is then you will go on to live with them.

sentence.sent_text: Eni-giizhi-wiidoopamadwaa, mii dash iwidi da-ni-wiij'ayaawadwaa.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, it is a beautiful place that you are going to.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash aw Waasigwan geget onaajiwan iwidi eni-izhaayan.

paragraph.text_eng: It is so beautiful up there that there is no dust.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin gegoo wiiyagasenh iwidi ayaamagasinoon ezhi-onaajiwang.

paragraph.text_eng: And everything that the Anishinaabe have been given ceremonial-wise, that is what happens over there.

sentence.sent_text: Naa-go gaye gakina gaa-izhi-ina'oonwewizid a'aw Anishinaabe inakamigizid, mii iw enakamigiziwaad iwidi.

paragraph.text_eng: It is especially happy over there; nothing will bother you.

sentence.sent_text: Geget ow minawaanigwad, gaawiin gegoo gida-wanishkwe'igosiin.

paragraph.text_eng: I have completed the talk that has been put here.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke mii imaa ani-giizhiikamaan ow gaagiigidowin omaa gaa-achigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: I called on that Manidoo several times in case we may have forgotten or left something out; that is the Manidoo that will correct any mistakes.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke moozhag nigii-nanaandomaa a'aw Manidoo omaa giishpin gegoo gii-waniikeyaang gii-waniwebinigeyaang, mii a'aw Manidoo ge-ni-nanaa'isidood.

paragraph.text_eng: Waasigwan, the Manidoog and your relatives will consider you being over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash i'iw Waasigwan, mii iwidi ge-danenimikwaa ingiw Manidoog biinish gaye gidinawemaaganag.

paragraph.text_eng: That is all I will say for the time being.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa minik inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Viewing

sentence.sent_text: Waabamind awiya.

paragraph.text_eng: This is the viewing; instructions are given out on what to do when viewing.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash apii da-ni-waabamind, mii imaa da-ni-wiindamawindwaa ge-izhichigewaad azhigwa ani-waabamind a'aw waa-ni-maajaad.

paragraph.text_eng: It is at this time you will view him.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owanpii ge-izhi-waabamegiban.

paragraph.text_eng: Be careful; don’t let water from you eyes or nose fall on the body when you are viewing him.

sentence.sent_text: Ayaangwaamizig sanaa gego imaa nibi gishkiinzhigowaang gijaanzhiwaang daa-wii-pangisinzinoon azhigwa imaa ani-waabameg.

paragraph.text_eng: If that happens, he will have a difficult time leaving and there will be a mist as he goes down that path.

sentence.sent_text: Giishpin i'iw izhiwebak, mii-go da-ni-gagwaadagitood ani-maajaad naa gaye da-ni-awanibiisaamagadinig imaa ani-bimi-ayaad imaa miikanensing.

paragraph.text_eng: Our old men of the past said that women who were expecting were not allowed to view the body, and also young children were not allowed to view the body.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye mii-ko ingiw akiwenziiyibaneg ogii-tazhindaanaawaa, a'aw ikwe gegishkawaad miinawaa ekawaabamaad oniijaanisan, gaawiin odaa-bi-waabamaasiin awiya, naa gaye ingiw bebiiwizhiiwijig abinoojiinyag gaawiin omaa odaa-bi-waabamaasiwaawaan awiya.

paragraph.text_eng: And also remember to take off your glasses when you are viewing.

sentence.sent_text: Naa gaye gidaa-wii-mikwendaanaawaa da-giizikameg inow gidooshkiinzhigokaaniwaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Be careful now.

sentence.sent_text: Ayaangwaamizig sanaa.

paragraph.text_eng: That is all I am saying.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa inwewetooyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell those present to smoke the tobacco.

sentence.sent_text: Wiindamawindwaa eyaajig imaa da-naabishkaagewaad inow asemaan.

paragraph.text_eng: The spirit of the one who has left has arrived where our relatives are. First the tobacco has been passed out. They are told to light up or put the tobacco in the fire. When they are done smoking, more talking will be done to address the tobacco and the food that is being offered up.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw iwidi gii-ni-dagoshimoonod gaa-ni-maajaa'ind iwidi ayaawaad gidinawemaaganinaanig.
Mii dash akawe asemaa maada'ookiing.
Mii omaa da-ni-wiindamawindwaa da-naabishkaagewaad inow asemaan.
Ani-giizhiitaang mii dash imaa nawaj ani-gaagiigidong ani-dazhimind a'aw asemaa miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: A small birch bark basket is placed in the fire, and in the little basket we put bits and pieces of the food brought into the feast, along with a drop of the drink being served and a pinch of tobacco. And this food is being sent to the one who has arrived over there where our relatives are. He will share in that meal with his relatives over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash owapii ani-aabajichigaadeg i'iw biskitenaagaans, wiisiniwin imaa achigaadeg imaa biinjina miinawaa waa-minikweng miinawaa a'aw asemaa.
Mii dash izhi-jaagizigaadeg ani-niindaa'iweng da-ni-izhaamagak gaa-izhaad a'aw gaa-ishkwaa-ayaad.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has been passed out to you.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw gii-paa-maada'oonigooyeg a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: You are going to accept the tobacco on behalf of the Manidoog in a good way.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa da-ni-naabishkaageyeg weweni.

paragraph.text_eng: See, this is why we are putting tobacco and food. It is at this time that Waasigwan arrives over there at that place called “Land of Everlasting Happiness.”

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash mii ow wenji-achigaazod a'aw asemaa miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin.
Mii iw noongom iwidi gii-ni-dagoshimoonod a'aw Waasigwan "Gaagige-minawaanigoziwining" ezhi-wiinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: When we get done accepting the tobacco, I will talk about the purpose of the tobacco and also the food.

sentence.sent_text: Eni-giizhi-naabishkaageyang, mii imaa da-ni-dazhimag a'aw asemaa enagimind miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin da-ni-dazhindamaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Let’s take in that tobacco for the Manidoog.

sentence.sent_text: Akawe dash ani-naabishkaagedaa a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell what the tobacco is designated for and talk for the food.

sentence.sent_text: Dazhinjigaazod enagimind a'aw asemaa biinish gaye wiisiniwin dazhinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: At this time the tobacco is being talked about and also the food that is being sent over there. The food is sent to the one that has arrived over there and also to the relatives that he has a reunion with.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash imaa ani-dazhinjigaazod a'aw asemaa miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin naandaa'iweng.
Mii imaa ani-niindaa'ind a'aw iwidi gaa-ni-dagoshimoonod biinish gaye odinawemaaganan gaa-odisaajin.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has gone out.

sentence.sent_text: Mii gii-ni-maadaabasod a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: It went to where all the Manidoog sit. We are thanking them for all that has been put in place that helped Waasigwan as he went along, eventually arriving over there completing the process of changing worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iwidi eni-inaabasod gakina enabiwaad ingiw Manidoog, mii imaa ani-miigwechiwi'indwaa inigokwekamig gaa-achigaadeg gaa-naadamaagod a'aw Waasigwan gaa-ni-apiichitaad biinish iwidi weweni gii-ni-dagoshimoonod gii-ni-giizhiikang gii-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: We are also thanking the Manidoog for the ability to send food over to where our relatives are.

sentence.sent_text: Naa-go gaye gimiigwechiwi'aanaanig ingiw Manidoog gii-miinigoowizid a'aw Anishinaabe da-niindaa'aad i'iw wiisiniwin inow odinawemaaganan iwidi eyaanijin.

paragraph.text_eng: And the tobacco also goes to the Manidoo that takes care of our relatives over there and to his helpers.

sentence.sent_text: Miinawaa ani-maadaabasod a'aw asemaa, mii iwidi ge-ni-inaabasod a'aw Manidoo iwidi eyaad genawenimaad gidinawemaaganinaanan miinawaa inow odooshkaabewisiman.

paragraph.text_eng: As Waasigwan arrives over there, they take him into this huge wigwam that sits sideways.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash azhigwa iwidi Waasigwan gii-ni-dagoshimoonod, mii iw iwidi gii-piindiganind a'aw chi-wiigiwaam iwidi bemidesing.

paragraph.text_eng: They will keep Waasigwan there for four days. Those old men say that their days are different than ours over there. The length of their day is equivalent the blink of an eye.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw iwidi niiyo-giizhik da-ganawenjigaazod a'aw Waasigwan.
Bakaan inendaagwadini ogiizhigadomiwaa iwidi, ingiw akiwenziiyibaneg gii-ikidowag.
Mii aabiding bapazangwaabiyang, mii iw ekwaamagadinig o'ow ogiizhigadomiwaa.

paragraph.text_eng: As soon as their four days have passed, the Manidoo in that wigwam tells his helpers, “Go tell the people that a relative of theirs has arrived”.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa gaa-niiyo-giizhigadinig wiinawaa ogiizhigadomiwaa iwidi, mii dash a'aw Manidoo eyaad imaa wiigiwaaming ezhi-wiindamawaad inow odooshkaabewisiman, "Daga baa-wiindamaw omaa eyaajig, bi-dagoshinini bezhig inow odinawemaaganiwaan."

paragraph.text_eng: And then they go and tell the people.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash geget baa-waawiindamaagewaad.

paragraph.text_eng: The food before us I am sending over there and also the food that was burnt in the fire arrives over there.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash o'ow wiisiniwin omaa etemagak, mii iwidi epagizondamaan miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin gaa-chaagizigaadeg, mii iw iwidi ezhaamagak gaye.

paragraph.text_eng: It is then that Waasigwan will eat with all his relatives that he has met up with.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash iwidi da-ni-wiidoopamaad inow odinawemaaganan gaa-odisaajin Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: There must be a lot of his relatives over there.

sentence.sent_text: Nebowa ayaadogenan odinawemaaganan iwidi.

paragraph.text_eng: We are not taking food from him. It not until they are all content that the food is gone. A small amount of food goes a long way in that world.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin gaye gimakandamawaasiwaanaan i'iw wiisiniwin.
Baanimaa gakina gii-tebisewendamowaad, mii iw da-gwiinawaabandamowaad i'iw wiisiniwin.
Waasa izhaamagad i'iw wiisiniwin iwidi.

paragraph.text_eng: We are not asking our relatives for life. If someone thinks that way, our relatives would feel bad.

sentence.sent_text: Miinawaa gaawiin bimaadiziwin ginandodamawaasiwaanaanig.
Mii-go ezhi-inigaawendamowaad giishpin awiya inendang i'iw akeyaa.

paragraph.text_eng: We are only doing good to Waasigwan and the relatives that he saw upon his arrival.

sentence.sent_text: Mii eta-go weweni doodawind a'aw Waasigwan miinawaa inow odinawemaaganan gaa-odisaajin.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco is also being put to help the close relatives to accept the decision of the Manidoog that it was time for Waasigwan to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash gaye a'aw asemaa enagimind, ingiw besho enawendaasojig oda-wii-ni-naadamaagowaan inow Manidoon da-ni-odaapinamowaad weweni gaa-inaakonigenid inow Manidoon-sa owapii gii-inendaagozid a'aw Waasigwan da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: That tobacco will also go to the Moon. If I should forget something or omit something, she will correct it.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash gaye iwidi ge-ni-inaabasod a'aw asemaa a'aw Giganaan.
Ishke giishpin gegoo omaa waniikeyaan waniwebinigeyaan, mii a'aw Manidoo ge-ni-nanaa'isidood.

paragraph.text_eng: You can put food every so often, remembering Waasigwan.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash ayaapii wiisiniwin gidaa-atamawaawaa Waasigwan da-ni-mikwenimeg.

paragraph.text_eng: See, if the Anishinaabe do not do that, their relatives over there will come to tell them that they want to be remembered. They usually dream about them.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke giishpin a'aw Anishinaabe ezhichigesig, obi-wiindamaagoon inow odinawemaaganan eyaanijin iwidi da-mikwenimindwaa.
Obawaanaawaan iko.

paragraph.text_eng: May the Manidoog have compassion for you all for completing this ceremony as we have been taught to do as Anishinaabe.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash gida-wii-shawenimigowaag ingiw Manidoog weweni ani-giizhiikameg o'ow akeyaa gaa-izhi-gikinoo'amaagoowiziyang da-ni-izhichigeyang anishinaabewiyang.

paragraph.text_eng: Now you can eat the food that will go to Waasigwan and his relatives over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go iw ge-izhi-naabishkaageyegiban i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: That’s it.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell those present to smoke the tobacco.

sentence.sent_text: Wiindamawindwaa eyaajig imaa da-naabishkaagewaad inow asemaan.

paragraph.text_eng: After a year has passed since their relative has passed on, some Anishinaabe put food and other items remembering their relative that has passed on. The tobacco has been passed out; at this time everyone is given permission to smoke or put their tobacco in the fire.

sentence.sent_text: Azhigwa i'iw bezhig i'iw gikinoonowin gaa-pimisemagak, mii owapii aanind a'aw Anishinaabe niindaa'aad i'iw wiisiniwin miinawaa ge-aabajitoonid inow odinawemaaganan gaa-wani'aajin.
Asemaa gii-maada'ookiim mii dash imaa apii ani-wiindamawindwaa da-ni-naabishkaagewaad inow asemaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Everyone has been handed tobacco and the food has been laid out, and also those things that will be sent to the one who is being remembered.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iw gii-paa-ininamaagooyeg a'aw asemaa miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin gii-kiizisijigaadeg, biinish gaye i'iw naandaa'ind a'aw mekwenimind.

paragraph.text_eng: The reason the tobacco, the food, and the gifts are going to be sent out is because it has been a year since Waasigwan was meant to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash a'aw asemaa, wiisiniwin, miinawaa bagijigan wenji-achigaadeg, mii iw bezhig i'iw gikinoonowin gii-pimisemagadinig owapii gaa-inendaagozid a'aw Waasigwan da-ni-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: His relatives are doing him good by remembering him. Take the tobacco in, in a good way.

sentence.sent_text: Weweni dash omaa odoodaagoon inow odinawemaaganan ani-mikwenimigod.
Weweni dash da-naabishkaageyeg a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: When you are done smoking I will go on to talk about the tobacco and all that has been placed here that will be sent out.

sentence.sent_text: Ani-giizhiitaayeg, mii imaa da-ni-dazhimag enagimind a'aw asemaa biinish gaye gakina omaa naandaa'iweng.

paragraph.text_eng: That is all I will say for now.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa akawe minik ani-izhi-gaagiigidoyaan.

paragraph.text_eng: Tell what the tobacco is designated for and talk for the food.

sentence.sent_text: Dazhinjigaazod enagimind a'aw asemaa biinish gaye wiisiniwin dazhinjigaadeg.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco is sent out and the food is sent over to where our relatives go. As the food arrives over there, the one who is being remembered is told and then he shares a meal with all his relatives over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash omaa ani-apagizonjigaazod a'aw asemaa miinawaa i'iw wiisiniwin apagizonjigaadeg iwidi ayaawaad gidinawemaaganinaanig.
Mii iwidi ani-dagoshimoonagak, mii dash ezhi-wiindamawind a'aw mekwenimind, mii dash imaa gakina inow odinawemaaganan da-wiidoopamigod.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco has arrived to where those Manidoog sit. The tobacco is being sent to them to thank the Manidoog for giving Anishinaabe the ability to send food and other items to their relatives who have gone to that place our relatives go when they are no longer seen here on earth.

sentence.sent_text: Mii iwidi enikaad a'aw asemaa ani-bagamimaasod iwidi gakina enabiwaad ingiw Manidoog.

Ishke dash enagimind a'aw asemaa, mii omaa ani-miigwechiwi'indwaa ingiw Manidoog gii-miinigoowizid a'aw Anishinaabe-sa da-niindaa'aad i'iw wiisiniwin miinawaa ge-ni-aabajitoonid odinawemaaganan iwidi gaa-izhaanijin eni-izhaad gidinawemaaganinaan gaagwiinawaabaminaagozid omaa akiing.

paragraph.text_eng: I do not know of any other people that have been given the ability to do this. The Manidoog really had compassion for the Anishinaabe by giving them this ceremony.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin ingikenimaasiin aw bekaanizid bemaadizid da-gii-miinigoowizipan i'iw da-izhichiged.
Geget ingiw Manidoog ogii-shawenimaawaan inow odanishinaabemiwaan gii-miinaawaad ow akeyaa da-ni-izhichigenid.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco is also arriving to the Manidoo over there that takes care of our relatives who have already changed worlds. That Manidoo will take the tobacco in a good way. The tobacco is also being given to his helpers as it arrives over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go gaye a'aw asemaa da-ni-bagamimaasod iwidi a'aw Manidoo eyaad genawenimaad inow gidinawemaaganinaanan gaa-aanjikiinijin.
Mii a'aw Manidoo weweni ge-ni-odaapinaad inow asemaan.
Biinish gaye mii iwidi ani-biindaakoonindwaa inow odooshkaabewisiman azhigwa ani-bagamimaasod iwidi a'aw asemaa.

paragraph.text_eng: And then that Manidoo over there tells his helpers to tell Waasigwan that he is being remembered.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash a'aw Manidoo iwidi eyaad izhi-wiindamawaad inow odooshkaabewisiman da-o-wiindamawaawaad-sa a'aw mekwenimind a'aw Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: Also his relatives that he has met up with and that met up with him will come with Waasigwan. It is over there that I am sending the food that has been placed here. And Waasigwan will share in a meal with all of his relatives that are over there.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go gaye gakina odinawemaaganan gaa-odisaajin biinish gaa-odisigojin da-bi-wiijiiwigod a'aw Waasigwan.
Mii dash iwidi ani-apagizondamaan o'ow wiisiniwin omaa gaa-achigaadeg.
Mii dash iwidi da-ni-wiidoopamaad a'aw Waasigwan inow odinawemaaganan iwidi eyaanijin.

paragraph.text_eng: There must be a lot of his relatives over there. Waasigwan will not be deprived of any of the food. The food will not be gone until they are all content.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke nebowa ayaadogenan inow odinawemaaganan iwidi.
Gaawiin gaye makandamawaasiin i'iw wiisiniwin a'aw Waasigwan baanimaa gakina gaa-tebisewendamowaad, mii iw da-gwiinawaabandamowaad i'iw wiisiniwin.

paragraph.text_eng: His relatives here are not asking that those who have passed on be given life. If someone were to think this way, the relatives over there would feel bad.

sentence.sent_text: Gaawiin gaye bimaadiziwin omisawendamaagosiin inow odinawemaaganan imaa eyaanijin.
Mii-go ezhi-inigaawendamowaad iwidi eyaajig, giishpin i'iw akeyaa inendang awiya.

paragraph.text_eng: His relatives here are only trying to do good to Waasigwan by remembering him, especially since it has been a year since it was meant for him to change worlds.

sentence.sent_text: Mii eta-go omaa weweni ani-doodaagod inow odinawemaaganan omaa eyaanijin ani-mikwenimigod Waasigwan o'owapii bezhig i'iw gikinoonowin gii-pimisemagak i'iwapii gii-inenimigod inow Manidoon da-aanjikiid.

paragraph.text_eng: I am also sending the items of clothing and all the miscellaneous useful items to Waasigwan.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash inow odayi'iimaanan miinawaa i'iw ge-ni-aabajitood awiya omaa gaa-achigaadegin, mii gaye iwidi ani-apagizondamaan ani-niindaa'ind a'aw Waasigwan.

paragraph.text_eng: This is what the Anishinaabe call “Giiweniged.”

sentence.sent_text: Mii ow "Giiweniged" ezhinikaadang a'aw Anishinaabe.

paragraph.text_eng: After we get done eating, the items from the bundle will be passed out to all of you here to accept on behalf of Waasigwan.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash ani-giizhi-naabishkaageng i'iw wiisiniwin, mii dash imaa da-ni-maada'ookiing inow bagijiganan da-ni-naabishkaageyeg minik ayaayeg omaa.

paragraph.text_eng: That way it will all arrive over there to him. Treat the items you have been given with respect. Make an effort to wear those items that you have been given as soon as possible and make an effort to use those miscellaneous items that you have also been given.

sentence.sent_text: Mii dash iwidi weweni da-ni-dagoshimoonagak.
Weweni manaajitoog omaa waa-paa-maada'oonigooyeg.
Wiikwajitoog wewiib da-biizikameg inow odayi'iimaanan gaa-paa-maamiinigooyegin, naa wewiib da-aabajitooyeg inow aabajichiganan gaa-paa-maamiinigooyegin.

paragraph.text_eng: If you cannot fit the clothing, you can give them to someone who can fit them. That way those things that are being sent over to Waasigwan will arrive there properly.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke minokanziweg inow biizikiganan, gidaa-miinaawaa awiya ge-minokang.
Mii dash ow weweni da-ni-dagoshimoonagak inow naandaa'iwengin.

paragraph.text_eng: The tobacco is also going out to that Manidoo the Anishinaabe rely on when they offer up their tobacco. That is the Manidoo that is named Giganaan. She is the one that will correct it if I were to forget something or make an error. That way everything will be accomplished that we wish to do through this ceremony.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash gaye ani-maadaabasod a'aw asemaa, mii iwidi ge-ni-inaabasod a'aw Manidoo epenimod a'aw Anishinaabe ani-asemaaked.
Mii dash a'aw Giganaan ezhi-wiinind.
Mii a'aw ge-ni-nanaa'isidood imaa giishpin gegoo ani-waniikeyaan ani-waniwebinigeyaan.
Weweni dash igo da-aawang i'iw akeyaa ezhi-bagosendamang omaa okwi'idiyang.

paragraph.text_eng: May you be shown compassion by those Manidoog for doing what is good for your relative that has gone on and changed worlds. The Manidoog must really enjoy and like what they see in you all for doing such a good thing today, continuing on this ceremony that we were given as Anishinaabe. May those Manidoog offer their compassion to you all as a result.

sentence.sent_text: Ishke dash omaa gidaa-wii-shawendaagozim omaa izhi-mino-doodaweg a'aw gidinawemaaganiwaa gaa-ni-aanjikiid.

Geget minwaabishinowidogenag gimino-waabamigoominaadog i'iw akeyaa ezhi-minochigeyeg omaa noongom ani-ayaangwaamitooyeg i'iw akeyaa gaa-izhi-gikinoo'amaagoowiziyang anishinaabewiyang da-ni-izhichigeyang.
Gidaa-wii-shawenimigowaag dash ingiw Manidoog.

paragraph.text_eng: That is all I want to say for now.

sentence.sent_text: Mii-go maa minik ezhi-gaagiigidoyaan.
